scientific_goal: Rank single amino-acid substitutions by their likely effect on protein fitness and, within a measurement budget, identify variants with high measured fitness.
input_entity: wild-type protein sequence and one or more substitutions (WT position MUT)
applicability: single-chain protein sequences up to the ESM-2 context limit
known_limits: scores are model predictions (E1), not fitness measurements
no experimental validation in this asset
ranking quality varies by protein and assay
sequence-only: ignores structure, ligands, and environment
historical_measurement: real DMS fitness measurements from ProteinGym v1 (SDA_BACSU_Tsuboyama_2023_1PV0), exposed only through the hidden evidence oracle (E3)
